name: What types of drywall are available for replacement, and which is best for water-prone areas?

mainEntity.name: What types of drywall are available for replacement, and which is best for water-prone areas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard drywall is common for general use, but for areas susceptible to moisture, there are better options. Green board (moisture-resistant drywall) has a water-resistant paper facing and is suitable for bathrooms or laundry rooms. Cement board offers superior water resistance and is often used in showers or as a tile backer. Purple drywall is enhanced to resist mold and moisture, making it a good choice for environments with elevated humidity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options include standard, green board (moisture-resistant), cement board (highly water-resistant), and purple drywall (mold/moisture-resistant).
